entries.d40df02ca99edf01: Headquartered in Matsumoto, Nagano Prefecture, the group consists of the company, six consolidated subsidiaries and one equity-method affiliate. The company operates a nursing and medical care-related business centered on the CS Set service for inpatients and residents of hospitals and nursing facilities. Consolidated employees as of December 31, 2025 numbered 974.

entries.ddcc6a641360e621: The number of facilities introducing the CS set rose from 2,570 at the end of the previous consolidated fiscal year to 2,830 at the end of the current consolidated fiscal year; against 359 new contracts, there were 99 cancellations.
entries.e5c90ce24d839183: CS set fees are a daily rate calculated by the number of days of hospitalization or admission rather than by what is used, so users can use the service without worrying about how often laundry and exchanges occur or how much daily necessities they use. Operations are structured so that facilities handle explanations to users, reception, lending, collection and distribution; linen supply companies, etc. handle delivery, collection and laundering; and the company group handles plan design, fee collection and inquiry response. Facilities can provide the service in a form that complies with administrative guidance on charging for services not covered by insurance, and the mechanism also reduces the workload of on-site laundry and replenishment of daily necessities.
entries.e67e5212cd27c3ba: A company headquartered in Matsumoto, Nagano Prefecture, that offers the "CS Set" to inpatients and residents of hospitals and nursing care facilities, combining rental of clothing and towels with a laundry service and the provision of daily necessities.
entries.ea8d6e7e6e4bd8ab: It is a service that provides the “CS set,” which combines rental and laundering of clothing and towels with sales of daily necessities, allowing users to be admitted to hospitals or facilities without having to bring their own items.
